title: Radiology Request and Reporting Procedure
content:
SOP: Radiology Request and Reporting Procedure (SOP-RAD-001)
DEPARTMENT: Radiology Operations
VERSION: 1.8
ROLES: doctor, rad_tech
PURPOSE: Safe diagnostic imaging acquisition and urgent PACS reporting.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Radiology Request and Reporting Procedure in full compliance with Radiology Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Radiology Request and Reporting Procedure in full compliance with Radiology Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Radiology Request and Reporting Procedure in full compliance with Radiology Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Radiology Request and Reporting Procedure in full compliance with Radiology Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Radiology Request and Reporting Procedure in full compliance with Radiology Operations hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Radiology Operations.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-RAD-001 Radiology Request and Reporting Procedure v1.8, Section 4
